findings.title: The GUI does not bind user confirmation to the plan that was reviewed
findings.remediation_evidence: internal/planner, internal/integrity, internal/state saved plans, Service.ApplyPlanned, UI/CLI plan identity
findings.verification_evidence: altered, expired, catalog-drifted, inventory-drifted, pre-mutation consumption, and replay-rejection tests

findings.title: Published binaries were built from a dirty pre-commit workspace, not the claimed source revision
findings.remediation_evidence: scripts/release.ps1 requires clean HEAD exactly at a verified signed annotated tag, imports the protected verification key, requires the tag commit to equal fetched origin/main, and asserts vcs.modified=false/revision
findings.verification_evidence: release script build metadata checks; protected tag workflow

findings.title: Release binaries use unsupported Go 1.23.2 and no applicability scan was run
findings.remediation_evidence: release/verify workflows and release script require Go 1.26.5 and pinned govulncheck; source and binary scans
findings.verification_evidence: CI/release vulnerability artifacts; release refuses older Go

findings.title: The Windows executables are unsigned and setup does not authenticate its sibling console binary
findings.remediation_evidence: setup embeds console SHA-256 and publisher thumbprint; VerifyReleasePair; PowerShell launcher and release require valid Authenticode
findings.verification_evidence: tamper tests plus signed Windows release verification

findings.title: An essential agent skill pack is cloned from an unpinned upstream branch
findings.remediation_evidence: skill pack catalog pins full Git commit and expected entries; installer fetches and verifies resolved commit before copy

findings.title: Successful installer exit is treated as verified installation without postcondition checks
findings.remediation_evidence: runner postcondition verifier rescans each successful install and records success only when expected state exists

findings.title: Loopback UI mutation authorization is not isolated to the current OS user
findings.remediation_evidence: high-entropy session path/token on every endpoint, origin/content/rate gates, current-user-only state ACL
findings.verification_evidence: UI authorization tests and Windows ACL E2E; docs disclose same-user malware residual

findings.title: No Windows x64 or ARM64 runtime end-to-end evidence exists
findings.remediation_evidence: .github/workflows/verify.yml native windows-2025 x64 and windows-11-arm ARM64 jobs; scripts/windows-e2e.ps1
findings.verification_evidence: release is blocked unless both required checks pass

findings.title: Mutating operations have no cross-process lock or transaction lease
findings.remediation_evidence: PID/instance-aware cross-process mutation lease in internal/state/lease.go used by apply/restore/lifecycle

findings.title: MCP doctor reports healthy when a child command exists but cannot initialize
findings.remediation_evidence: MCP doctor performs real initialize and tools/list, reports per-child failure, and caches briefly

findings.title: Existing runtimes are adopted without minimum-version or compatibility validation
findings.remediation_evidence: catalog version policies and bounded probes; planner preserves incompatible runtime unless explicit exact upgrade consent

findings.title: Router registration conflicts and Codex lookup failures can silently leave sessions on stale configuration
findings.remediation_evidence: Codex/AGY classification: absent/equivalent/owned-stale/foreign-conflict/read-failure; backup and owned repair only

findings.title: External package and inventory operations lack bounded per-operation timeouts
findings.remediation_evidence: invocation-specific timeouts for inventory, install, warm, doctor, session, and lifecycle operations

findings.title: Child MCP and session process trees are not reliably terminated on Windows
findings.remediation_evidence: Unix process groups and Windows Job Objects with kill-on-close, timeout and graceful-close escalation
findings.verification_evidence: parent/grandchild process-tree tests on Linux and both Windows CI architectures

findings.title: CI does not build or verify the actual distributable release archives
findings.remediation_evidence: signed release workflow builds and attests actual ZIPs, ARM64 consumes and verifies the produced archive, and publication is a separate dependent job that cannot run before both architectures pass
findings.verification_evidence: archive verification and protected release checks

findings.title: WinGet inventory is captured as raw text but not parsed or reconciled
findings.remediation_evidence: structured WinGet JSON parsing/reconciliation plus minimized external inventory

findings.title: The GUI custom profile silently selects Playwright despite documentation saying no defaults
findings.remediation_evidence: custom has no defaults/providers; provider selection derives only from selected components/explicit override

findings.title: Most credential integrations are catalog placeholders rather than installable integrations
findings.remediation_evidence: credential components are explicitly installable or guidedSetup; each has login hint, official HTTPS documentation URL, status and verification instructions
findings.verification_evidence: catalog validation plus agentstack integrations tests

findings.title: Transactions are persisted only after all installer actions finish
findings.remediation_evidence: transaction saved before execution and after every action, including skips and dependency suppression; journal failures fail the transaction; startup recovers interrupted running state

findings.title: Raw machine inventory and command output are persisted without minimization or deletion controls
findings.remediation_evidence: persisted inventory and transaction journals are minimized; command arguments/stdout/stderr are omitted, nested secrets are redacted, and export/clear/policy commands plus age retention cover plans, transactions, diagnostics and events

findings.title: Sensitive and expensive UI GET endpoints require no token
findings.remediation_evidence: all UI reads and mutations require token; secret per-process session URL; request rate/body/content/origin gates

findings.title: MCP protocol version is hard-coded instead of negotiated
findings.remediation_evidence: router negotiates a supported protocol from client initialization and rejects invalid lifecycle/order

findings.title: Release-critical runtime paths have low or zero test coverage
findings.remediation_evidence: critical-path coverage script requires named authorization/install/restore/lifecycle/process/session/UI functions to be exercised; Windows E2E supplements unit coverage

findings.title: No SBOM, license inventory, VEX, or dependency provenance covers the installed stack
findings.remediation_evidence: catalog-wide schema-valid deterministic CycloneDX generator, per-architecture Syft SBOMs attested against the exact raw signed binaries they describe, license inventory, govulncheck OpenVEX, valid in-toto/SLSA provenance, immutable action/image pins, and GitHub attestations

findings.title: Live repository documentation drift removes material security and recovery caveats
findings.remediation_evidence: rewritten user/security/release/privacy/operations/governance docs plus static drift check in CI/release

findings.title: Backups are created but no supported restore workflow exists
findings.remediation_evidence: indexed backup list, digest/target/structure preview, confirmed restore, live post-restore MCP validation, and automatic rollback on failed validation

findings.title: “Reproducible” release claim is inaccurate for archives and clean source builds
findings.remediation_evidence: claim narrowed to two-build unsigned binary reproducibility; deterministic ZIP metadata; clean tag/source archive
findings.verification_evidence: release script compares binaries and releasepack deterministic tests

findings.title: One-shot child MCP startup per tool call creates avoidable latency and repeated package resolution
findings.remediation_evidence: pooled persistent MCP child client with bounded graceful shutdown and invalid-child eviction

findings.title: Operational observability is insufficient for support and incident reconstruction
findings.remediation_evidence: local structured redacted events with correlation IDs, duration/status and MCP child observer; sanitized diagnostics
findings.verification_evidence: event redaction/rotation and diagnostic bundle tests

findings.title: Random mutation token generation fails open to a predictable timestamp value
findings.remediation_evidence: token/session RNG failure aborts UI startup; no predictable fallback

findings.title: The Linux binary is shipped by the build process but automatic catalog actions and router commands are Windows-specific
findings.remediation_evidence: public release target is Windows only; catalog has platform declarations; release/build docs no longer ship a Linux product
findings.verification_evidence: catalog platform tests and docs contract

findings.title: Accessibility is unmeasured for the browser-based manager UI
findings.remediation_evidence: semantic HTML, skip link, keyboard focus, live regions, reduced motion; Playwright + axe WCAG automation

findings.title: No fuzzing, property testing, or mutation testing covers parsers and preservation invariants
findings.remediation_evidence: fuzz targets for catalog, planner, state, safe files, MCP; pinned Gremlins mutation job and quality gate
findings.verification_evidence: fuzz seed campaign and mutation artifact

findings.title: Windows file confidentiality relies on inherited ACLs and was not verified
findings.remediation_evidence: Windows DACL applies/audits current-user-only access; POSIX mode 0700

findings.title: Automatic WinGet and uv installs are not fully locked to approved sources and versions
findings.remediation_evidence: exact WinGet ID/version/source/publisher; exact uv/npm versions/sources/publishers; catalog rejects floating acquisitions
findings.verification_evidence: catalog supply-chain validation and runner argument tests

findings.title: Child MCP stderr/stdout handling is unbounded and error-path synchronization is weak
findings.remediation_evidence: bounded MCP message/stdout/stderr, synchronized request handling, deadlines, process-tree termination

findings.title: Managed router and skill ownership state can become stale or overstate presence
findings.remediation_evidence: every inventory refresh reconciles managed router/paths/skills and updates ownership health/version/last verification
findings.verification_evidence: ownership health and repair classification tests

findings.title: No supported third-party uninstall or profile deactivation lifecycle exists
findings.remediation_evidence: ownership-scoped preview/deactivate/remove; provider uninstall commands; skill quarantine; manual/unowned refusal
findings.verification_evidence: lifecycle tests and explicit --yes CLI gates

findings.title: The essential profile is broad for a default baseline
findings.remediation_evidence: minimal six-component core default; broad essential retained only as a labeled legacy compatibility profile

findings.title: CLI help documents only four of nine available profiles
findings.remediation_evidence: CLI help and docs enumerate all ten catalog-driven profiles dynamically
findings.verification_evidence: CLI options/help tests and docs contract
